rv.q: Blue Raincoat Theatre Company delivers a powerful and timely environmental message in miniature
The company's slow burning artistry does the talking in a way that transcends words.
This is nevertheless a visual feast which focuses on the sounds and beauty of nature, and beguiles and provokes because of, not in spite of its verbal silence.

cn.t: Blue Raincoat Theatre's wordless production earns strong praise for its sensory, dreamlike quality that transcends traditional theatrical conventions.
